hero.title:
Choose the right plan

for your business
hero.subtitle: Choose the perfect plan that fits your needs—whether you're a small business or a large established corporation.

notes.prices: All prices are in ILS (₪), excluding VAT.
notes.annual: Annual plans pay the year up front; usage charges still bill monthly.
notes.changes: Upgrades apply immediately with credit for unused time; downgrades take effect at the end of the current period.

setupFee.promoEnds: One-time setup & onboarding fee {was} {now} + VAT — ends {date}
setupFee.firstSubscription: First subscriptions include a one-time {fee} + VAT setup & onboarding fee — never charged again, including on plan changes.

suspended.title: Your subscription is suspended
suspended.body: A payment failed and service is paused. Update your card to retry the charge and restore service — plan changes come after that.

pastDue.title: Your last payment failed
pastDue.body: We'll retry automatically, or <link>update your card</link> to retry now. You can still change plans in the meantime.

pending.title: Almost there — add a card to activate
pending.bodyWithPlan: {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) is reserved for you. Your subscription starts once a card is added.
pending.body: Your subscription starts once a card is added.

cancellation.title: Cancellation scheduled
cancellation.body: Your subscription ends on {date}. You can resume it from the <link>billing page</link>.
cancellation.bodyNoDate: Your subscription ends on the current period's end. You can resume it from the <link>billing page</link>.

planChange.title: Plan change scheduled
planChange.body: Your plan changes to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) on {date}. Choosing a different plan below replaces this change.
planChange.bodyNoDate: Your plan changes to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) on the next renewal. Choosing a different plan below replaces this change.

viewOnly.title: View only
viewOnly.body: Subscriptions are managed by the business owner and admins.

cta.switchInterval: Switch to {interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}} billing

inboundMinutes.label: Inbound AI minutes
inboundMinutes.tooltip: AI-answered inbound call minutes included every month. Overage rates apply beyond this allowance.

inboundOverage.label: Inbound overage
inboundOverage.tooltip: Per-minute rate for inbound AI minutes beyond the monthly allowance.

outbound.label: Outbound calls (PAYG)
outbound.tooltip: Per-minute rate for AI outbound calls. Pay as you go — billed monthly for what you use, no allowance to buy.

transferMinutes.label: Transfer minutes
transferMinutes.tooltip: Minutes of calls transferred to your team included every month.

transferOverage.label: Transfer overage
transferOverage.tooltip: Per-minute rate for transferred minutes beyond the monthly pool.

agents.label: AI agents
agents.tooltip: How many AI receptionists you can run, each with its own number, script and hours.

includedNumbers.label: Phone numbers included
includedNumbers.tooltip: Dedicated phone numbers included with the plan.

extraNumbers.label: Extra phone numbers
extraNumbers.tooltip: Monthly price for each additional number beyond those included.

seats.label: Team seats
seats.tooltip: Team member accounts that can access this business.

answering.label: 24/7 AI call answering
answering.tooltip: Your AI receptionist answers every inbound call around the clock — no missed calls, no voicemail.

recordings.label: Call recordings & transcripts
recordings.tooltip: Every call is recorded and transcribed so you can review conversations any time.

booking.label: Appointment booking
booking.tooltip: The AI books appointments straight into your calendar during the call.

leadCapture.label: Lead capture
leadCapture.tooltip: Caller details and enquiries are captured automatically as leads.

quotesJobsInvoices.label: Quotes, jobs & invoices
quotesJobsInvoices.tooltip: Turn calls into quotes, jobs and invoices without re-typing details.

screenedTransfers.label: Screened transfers
screenedTransfers.tooltip: The AI announces the caller and reason first, so your team can accept or decline before being connected.

extraction.label: AI data extraction
extraction.tooltip: Automatically pulls structured details — contact info, job requests, quote details — out of every call.

retention.label: Recording retention
retention.tooltip: How long call recordings are kept before automatic deletion.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}})
subscribe.description: Nothing is charged yet — this first charge runs as soon as your card is added.
subscribe.planLine: {plan} plan ({interval, select, monthly {first month} other {first year}})
subscribe.dueOnCard: Due when your card is added
subscribe.renewsMonthly: Renews monthly. Usage beyond your included allowances is billed with each renewal.
subscribe.renewsAnnually: The plan renews yearly; usage beyond your included allowances is still billed monthly.
subscribe.setupFeeOnce: The setup fee is once per business — never charged again.

toasts.reserved: {plan} reserved — add a card to start.

change.title: Change to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}})
change.description: Review what happens before anything changes.
change.creditBanked: {amount} of unused prepaid time becomes account credit and is applied to future charges automatically.
change.startsImmediately: Your new plan and a fresh billing period start immediately.
change.scheduledOn: Your plan changes to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) on {date}. Until then everything stays on your current plan.
change.scheduledAtRenewal: Your plan changes to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) on the next renewal. Until then everything stays on your current plan.

card.descriptionActivate: Card details go straight to Stripe's secure form — we never see the number. Saving the card starts your subscription.
card.descriptionRetry: Saving a new card immediately retries the failed charge — service is restored as soon as it succeeds.
card.descriptionUpdate: Card details go straight to Stripe's secure form — we never see the number. Future charges use the new card.
card.loadFailed: The payment form failed to load. Check your connection and try again.
card.processingBody: Stripe is still confirming your card. Your subscription updates automatically the moment it settles — this can take a minute. It's safe to close this window.

toasts.declined: The card was declined. Please try another card.
toasts.unexpected: The payment form returned an unexpected result. Please try again.
